logline: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 29 where Juliana was locked away in the castle's subterranean wet cells, vowing never to let them take Alexander from her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle tracking shot following polished black dress shoes and the tip of a gold-handled cane striding deliberately along a sunlit marble hallway, tilting up gradually to reveal an austere, grey-haired elder nobleman.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Rhythmic, heavy footsteps and the sharp metallic click of a cane striking the polished stone floor.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Elder Nobleman walks with stern, unhurried authority, dressed in an immaculate black tailcoat and dark vest with a gold pocket watch chain.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Rupert standing nervously beside ornate double doors, wearing black gloves and an embroidered dark coat, glancing up with anxiety.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A firm tap of the wooden walking stick halting against the floor.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot profile of the Elder Nobleman facing Rupert in the vaulted corridor.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Accusatory)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Rupert defensive and agitated.

segments.label: RUPERT (Defensive, Anxious)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman fixing Rupert with a piercing, contemptuous glare.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Stern, Disapproving)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.

segments.label: RUPERT (Muttered, Paranoid)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: She knows the Duchess was poisoned.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on the Elder Nobleman's unyielding eyes narrowing in cold calculation.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.

segments.label: RUPERT (Fearful)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: If she speaks...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Fierce, Venomous)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.

segments.label: RUPERT (Faltering, Submissive)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: What are you suggesting?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculated, Ominous)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: We stop hiding the prisoner.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Deadpan, Sinister)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: We give them a reason to condemn her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of Catherine standing regally before the roaring stone hearth, dressed in an ornate burgundy and gold brocade gown, slowly unfurling a red lace fan.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Inquiring, Sharp)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You have a solution?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Ruthless)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: We use the law to destroy her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Rupert looking bewildered.

segments.label: RUPERT (Confused)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: The law?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tracking medium shot as the Elder Nobleman paces slowly behind the massive mahogany desk lined with books and a glass of whiskey.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Pragmatic, Scheming)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: A maid with herbs in her possession, a secret medicine, an unauthorized visit to the Duchess's chamber.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Elder Nobleman leans both hands against the desk, leaning forward intently.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine fluttering her fan beneath her chin, smirking approvingly.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot framing the Elder Nobleman seated at the desk beside Catherine standing in the firelight.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Calculating)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine gently moving her fan, raising an intrigued brow.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Curious, Conniving)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: And if she claims she is a healer?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of the Elder Nobleman's face illuminated by warm firelight.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Sinister)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Then call it witchcraft.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Rupert wide-eyed with shock at the severity of the plan.

segments.label: RUPERT (Stunned)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: Witchcraft is a capital charge.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Straight-on close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring back without a flicker of remorse.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Unflinching)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Precisely.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium three-shot framing Rupert, the Elder Nobleman between them, and Catherine listening closely.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Command)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine smiling with malicious satisfaction, fluttering her fan.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Scheming)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Her botanical ledger...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Elder Nobleman nodding slowly.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Confirming)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Exactly.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Inquiring)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: And the Dowager?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Elder Nobleman gesturing dismissively with one gloved hand.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Dismissive)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Rupert exhaling deeply, processing the horrifying certainty of their conspiracy.

segments.label: RUPERT (Hesitant)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: And Juliana?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring sternly across the desk.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Resolute)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: She goes before the magistrate tomorrow.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine beaming with venomous glee, spreading her red fan wide.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Exultant)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: She will hang. A perfect solution. The town will cheer as the witch's disgraced daughter faces the noose.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert pulling out the desk chair and seating himself with dark resolve.

segments.label: RUPERT (Resolute, Vengeful)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: I will write the arrest warrant myself.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of the Elder Nobleman's weathered face, his eyes cold and predatory in the firelight.

segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Chilling, Decisive)
segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch.

scenes.heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High-angle shot peering down through the heavy iron dungeon grate into the flooded, pitch-black subterranean wet cells where water drips continuously.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Echoing, hollow water droplets splashing into dark pools beneath stone vaults, accompanied by a somber orchestral swell.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot pushing in on Juliana huddled against the wet stone wall, chained by the wrists, shivering in wet rags as faint moonlight filters down through the grate above.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana clutches a rough burlap rag to her trembling chest, her tear-stained face lifting upward in dread and fragile hope as the frame holds, cutting abruptly to black.
